_about: Boeing MD-80 Airplane Characteristics for Airport Planning (Rev. 12/89), 2.2 General Airplane Dimensions, Model MD-81, -82, -83 and -88 (page index 10): a 1-bit scan (about 300 dpi) over a printed grid. Its side view, raw image cropped 470,1330,2110,1780, enlarged 4 times (bicubic), turned -0.52° (the sheet's skew and the aircraft's ground attitude: the crown and belly level), thresholded at 128. Pixels of that raster, line centres: nose tip 274, tail cone 5832 (41.58 m), the tube's centreline 1033.5. Only the JT8D-200 nacelle is traced here; the rest of the airframe is the MD-90's (recipe).
